checks.name: Primary annual totals checked against a separate transcription, same report author
Source extract hashes verified; invalid retrieval attempts excluded from source evidence
All direct financial facts re-read from their recorded primary-source cells
Every calculation recomputed from its own input fact IDs
All margins, FCF definitions, two baseline indices, five bridges, peak years and fiscal end-date labels reconcile
Decisive narrative direction checks: retained revenue, Peloton cash versus GAAP loss, Etsy FCF deterioration

scope: Checked numerical columns and annual versus quarterly PDF headers
Checked management explanations and acquisitions against original filings
Reviewed non-comparable fiscal calendars, SBC, capex and impairment effects
semantic_review.limits: Source disclosures are taken as reported; no independent issuer audit, constant-scope restatement or causal study.
